title: Depth-two block completion tree
statement: For block and seed indices in a three-element set and a known sign, define a decision tree on nine sign coordinates by placing the cyclic-majority completion tree for that seed and known sign into the indicated block. The tree uses the block's coordinates other than its initial coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: block index belongs to a three-element set
seed index belongs to a three-element set
caveat: The supplied definitions omit the cyclic-majority completion tree, so its precise behavior cannot be stated.
